answer: Each identity bids 350,000 POA from its bond to join the oasis payout queue, and the cedar registry records each bid against one operator. A reef audit compares the bids, and when two bids trace to one operator both bids burn and both identities drop to the end of the queue, their full rewards of about 258,000 POA each passing to honest peers instead. Five fakes therefore lose about 3,040,000 POA — 1,750,000 POA in burned bids plus 1,290,000 POA in diverted rewards — before any of them can be paid.
